title: An Evaluation Dataset and Strategy for Building Robust Multi-turn Response Selection Model

bias_targets.target: Keyword and topic bias (Superficial pattern bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness using an adversarial dataset of manually crafted incorrect responses that contain high keyword or topic overlap with the context but feature semantic mismatches (e.g., altered negation, tense, subject-object confusion, lexical contradiction). Models are tested on their over-reliance on these superficial lexical similarities (measured via Jaccard similarity) rather than true contextual understanding.

primary_bias_target: Keyword and topic bias (Superficial pattern bias)
